# Fitness Calculation

This script is to calculate survival and growth in the mesocosm experiments. 

## Data processing

```{r data pre-process}
# data cleaning to just relevant columns
fit_trim <- fit[,c("DNA_label", "new_label", "pop", "genet", "bagnum", "tank_ID", "sal_full", "temp_full", "trt", "nbr_leaves_start", "sideShoot", "nbr_sideShootLeaves_start", "length_longest_leaf_start", "weight_start", "IsBlackLesions_start", "nbr_leaves_end", "nbr_new_leaves", "width_leaf", "Growth_leaf1", "Growth_leaf2", "Growth_leaf3", "Growth_leaf4", "Growth_leaf5", "Growth_leaf6", "Growth_leaf7", "Length_new_leaf1", "Length_new_leaf2", "Length_new_leaf3", "Length_new_leaf4", "Length_new_leaf5", "Length_new_leaf6", "Nbr_new_shoots", "Nbr_leaves_new_shoot1", "Length_new_shoot1_leaf1", "Length_new_shoot1_leaf2", "Length_new_shoot1_leaf3", "Length_new_shoot1_leaf4", "Length_new_shoot1_leaf5", "Length_new_shoot1_leaf6", "Nbr_leaves_new_shoot2", "Length_new_shoot2_leaf1", "Length_new_shoot2_leaf2", "Length_new_shoot2_leaf3", "Length_new_shoot2_leaf4", "Length_new_shoot2_leaf5", "below_ground_weight", "above_ground_weight", "weight_new_shoot1", "weight_new_shoot2", "total_weight", "lesions.", "isAlive", "Length_flower1", "Length_bract1")]

# binary survival column
fit_trim$isAlive <- ifelse(fit_trim$isAlive == TRUE, 1, 0)

# pop_trt factor for later significance testing
fit_trim$pop_trt <- as.factor(paste0(fit_trim$pop, "_", fit_trim$trt))

# length and weight growth
# for the growth analyses, we want a df with no flowering individuals and no dead individuals
fit_growth <- fit_trim_env[is.na(fit_trim_env$Length_flower1),]
fit_growth <- fit_growth[fit_growth$isAlive == 1,]

# standardized growth variables
# length
fit_growth$length_growth <- rowSums(fit_growth[,c("Growth_leaf1", "Growth_leaf2", "Growth_leaf3", "Growth_leaf4", "Growth_leaf5", "Growth_leaf6", "Growth_leaf7", "Length_new_leaf1", "Length_new_leaf2", "Length_new_leaf3", "Length_new_leaf4", "Length_new_leaf5", "Length_new_leaf6", "Length_new_shoot1_leaf1", "Length_new_shoot1_leaf2", "Length_new_shoot1_leaf3", "Length_new_shoot1_leaf4", "Length_new_shoot1_leaf5", "Length_new_shoot1_leaf6", "Length_new_shoot2_leaf1", "Length_new_shoot2_leaf2", "Length_new_shoot2_leaf3", "Length_new_shoot2_leaf4", "Length_new_shoot2_leaf5")], na.rm = T)

# standardized length growth
fit_growth$length_std_change <- fit_growth$length_growth / fit_growth$length_longest_leaf_start

# weight
fit_growth$weight_change <- fit_growth$total_weight - fit_growth$weight_start

# standardized weight change
fit_growth$weight_std_change <- fit_growth$weight_change / fit_growth$weight_start

# ratio of above vs below ground weight
fit_growth$above_below_weight_ratio <- fit_growth$above_ground_weight / fit_growth$below_ground_weight

# save outputs
#write.csv(fit_trim, "data/experiment/expfit_trim.csv", row.names = F)
#write.csv(fit_growth, "data/experiment/expfit_grow_trim.csv", row.names = F)
```

## Fitness Metrics

I will calculate pop/trt level survival, length change, and weight change.

```{r}
# just survival info
fit_surv <- fit_trim[,c("new_label","bagnum","tank_ID","pop","trt","pop_trt","isAlive")]

# calculate survival
surv <- fit_surv %>% 
  group_by(pop, trt) %>% 
  summarize(surv_mean = mean(isAlive), 
            surv_sd = sd(isAlive))

# calculate growth
grow <- fit_growth %>% 
  group_by(pop, trt) %>% 
  summarize(len_mean = mean(length_std_change, na.rm = T), 
            len_sd = sd(length_std_change, na.rm = T), 
            weigh_mean = mean(weight_std_change, na.rm = T), 
            weigh_sd = sd(weight_std_change, na.rm = T))

# put it together
expfit <- merge(surv, grow, by = c("pop", "trt"), all = T)

# add pop info
exp_pops$order <- 1:8
exp_pops$pop <- exp_pops$site_abbrev
expfit_mg <- merge(exp_pops, expfit, by = "pop")
```

## Plotting

Plotting averages

```{r}
# survival
ggplot(expfit_mg, aes(x = fct_reorder(pop, order), y = trt, fill = surv_mean)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", direction = 1, limits = c(0,1), na.value = "white") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Survival in Mesocosm Treatments", x = "Population", y = "Treatment", fill = "Survival")

# length
ggplot(expfit_mg, aes(x = fct_reorder(pop, order), y = trt, fill = len_mean)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", direction = 1, limits = c(0,5), na.value = "white") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Length Change in Mesocosm Treatments", x = "Population", y = "Treatment", fill = "∆Length")

# weight
ggplot(expfit_mg, aes(x = fct_reorder(pop, order), y = trt, fill = weigh_mean)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", direction = 1, limits = c(-0.7,0.4), na.value = "white") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Weight Change in Mesocosm Treatments", x = "Population", y = "Treatment", fill = "∆Weight")
```

Plotting common garden vs current future comparisons

```{r}
## survival
###########
trt_order <- c("TempControl_21psu", "TempWarm_16psu", "TempControl_7psu", "TempWarm_5psu")

# pop x trt
ggplot(expfit_mg, aes(x = fct_reorder(pop, order), y = surv_mean, fill = trt)) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Treatment",
                    values = c("#5bc0be","#a5be00","#003459","#245501"),
                    labels = c("Current W Coast", "Current E Coast",
                               "Future W Coast", "Future E Coast")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 24), 
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "right") +
  xlab("Population") + 
  ylab("Survival") +
  ggtitle("Survival by Population & Treatment", subtitle = "Current-Future Comparison")
```
